dropped.finding: The new SnapshotError fail-closed arm of `_unscoped_head_drift` (attested opcert whose configured gate ref cannot be resolved locally -> returns the 'refusing to certify against the working tree' stale-head reason) has no test. This is newly introduced behavior (all of `_unscoped_head_drift` is added, lines 456-489) and is the commit's headline contract ('fail CLOSED honestly when the gate ref cannot be resolved (never emit a foreign value)'). Named violating input: an attested unscoped opcert evaluated where the configured gate ref (origin/main) is unresolvable — e.g. no `origin` remote pushed / ref deleted — must return the honest cannot-resolve reason, not certify. A regression that fell through to a working-tree read here would not be caught.
